cell.tie_max_dist_nm_source: VOL/magic/sky130A.tech:4163-4170 (volare fa87f8f4): LU.2 N-diff to P-tap, LU.2.1 the same in deep n-well, LU.3 P-diff to N-tap, each '< 15.0um'; the deck's LU.2/LU.2.1/LU.3 rules. Read by no code yet (CELL-13 tap reach).
cell.lod_kvth0_n_mv_um_source: BSIM4 LOD KVTH0 of the installed models (sky130A libs.ref sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8__tt.pm3.spice: kvth0 = 9.8e-9 V.m), in mV.um: dVT = KVTH0 * d(1/(SA+L/2) + 1/(SB+L/2)). Kstress (lkvth0/wkvth0/pkvth0 = 0) is 1.
cell.lod_kvth0_p_mv_um_source: BSIM4 LOD KVTH0 of the installed models (sky130A pfet_01v8: sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8__kvth0_diff = 3.29e-8 V.m at tt), in mV.um: dVT = KVTH0 * d(1/(SA+L/2) + 1/(SB+L/2)). Kstress (lkvth0/wkvth0/pkvth0 = 0) is 1.
cell.avt_n_mv_um_source: Monte Carlo of the installed models: benchmarks/characterize_mismatch.py, .lib sky130.lib.spice tt_mm (MC_MM_SWITCH=1), 250 pairs x 6 W/L (1/0.15..8/2 um), constant-current VT at 0.1uA*W/L, sigma(dVT) fit through origin vs 1/sqrt(WL); seeds 1,2 gave 9.32, 9.66 -> mean 9.5. Model card alone: sqrt(2)*vth0_slope 3.356e-3 = 4.7 mV.um (toxe/voff terms add the rest). Gradient S_VT is wafer-level and not in the models, so gradient_per_avt_um2 stays absent.
cell.avt_p_mv_um_source: Monte Carlo of the installed models: benchmarks/characterize_mismatch.py, same method as avt_n; seeds 1,2 gave 11.84, 11.18 -> mean 11.5. Point estimates range 8.4 (8/2) to 12.4 (1/0.15): the pfet card bins vth0_slope 4.356..7.356e-3, so A_VT is geometry dependent.
cell.svt_uv_per_um_source: PROXY, not sky130 data: Schaper & Linnenbank (Infineon), 'Comparison of distance mismatch and pair matching of CMOS devices', IEEE, 130nm thin-oxide NMOS, Table 1 distance parameter S_D [mV/mm = uV/um] of dVGS: L/W 0.12/1.6 -> 1.63, 0.24/1.6 -> 0.780, 0.24/12.8 -> 0.941, 0.48/1.6 -> 0.582, 0.48/3.2 -> 0.644; Fig. 8: S_D^2 grows with 1/Leff^2. Worst case (shortest L, nearest sky130 Lmin 0.15) taken so the Pelgrom distance limit errs tight for every L. Replace with measured sky130 gradient data when available. Same S used for pfet (paper has NMOS only).
cell.em_current_density_source: rules EM.met1_mcon, EM.met2_via1 .. EM.met5_via4 (IHP convention: a metal with the cut below it; max_density is the metal's, max_current_per_cut the cut's) from sky130A/libs.ref/sky130_fd_sc_hd/techlef/sky130_fd_sc_hd__nom.tlef (volare fa87f8f4): DCCURRENTDENSITY AVERAGE met1 2.8, met2 2.8, met3 6.8, met4 6.8, met5 10.17 mA/um; mcon 0.36, via 0.29, via2 0.48, via3 0.48, via4 2.49 mA per via; Iavg_max at Tj=90C. Stored as uA/um and uA/cut. li1 has no EM limit in the PDK, so li is not covered.
cell.em_derating_source: Iavg_max at Tj=90C, sky130A/libs.ref/sky130_fd_sc_hd/techlef/sky130_fd_sc_hd__nom.tlef:92,119 (volare fa87f8f4); Ea and n not stated by the PDK
cell.antenna_source: sky130A/libs.tech/magic/sky130A.tech (volare fa87f8f4), 'model partial', no-diode ratios. rules ANT.licon/mcon/via1..via4 (surface): 'antenna allcont surface 3', 'mcon surface 3', 'v1 surface 3', 'v2 surface 6', 'v3,v4 surface 6' (techlef ANTENNADIFFAREARATIO agrees). Sidewall rules are the deck's ar.li.1, ar.met1.1..ar.met5.1; the same file agrees: 'antenna li sidewall 75', 'antenna m1,m2,m3 sidewall 400', 'antenna m4,m5 sidewall 400', 'height' lines allli 0.10, allm1 0.36, allm2 0.36, allm3 0.845, allm4 0.845, allm5 1.26 um (the deck states met1/met2 350 nm, sc_hd techlef THICKNESS; ar.met3.1 corrected 2000 -> 845 nm by a # PHILIS: edit). 'antenna poly sidewall 50' is not encoded. Diode PWL terms not encoded.
cell.vt_tc_uv_per_k_source: nfet_01v8 |dVT/dT|, magnitude (VT falls with T): `benchmarks/characterize_mismatch.py tc`, ngspice-44.2, .lib sky130.lib.spice tt (volare fa87f8f4), diode-connected, constant-current VT at Id=0.1uA*W/L, temp 0/27/85/125 C, least-squares slope: 2/0.5 um -776, 4/1 um -754 uV/K -> 765. The library reads this single key for both polarities; pfet is in vt_tc_uv_per_k_p.
cell.vt_tc_uv_per_k_p_source: pfet_01v8 |dVT/dT|, same method and run as vt_tc_uv_per_k: 2/0.5 um -1940, 4/1 um -1760 uV/K -> 1850. Not read by the library yet (single key).
cell.density_source: rules met1..met4_max_density from sky130A/libs.ref/sky130_fd_sc_hd/techlef/sky130_fd_sc_hd__nom.tlef (volare fa87f8f4): met1-met4 MAXIMUMDENSITY 70, DENSITYCHECKWINDOW 700 700, DENSITYCHECKSTEP 70 (um); met5 has none. Not encoded (chip-level, no window): libs.tech/klayout/drc/met_min_ca_density.lydrc min clear-area density li1/m1-m4 0.4, m5 0.24 over the chip boundary (i.e. metal <= 60% / 76% of the die). No minimum metal density found in the installed PDK files.
cell.inapplicable_rules_note: Deck rules for structures no Philis generator draws (the varactor: poly over tap in nwell): they must not set generator dimensions. The checker still runs every rule.

bjts.note: sky130 vertical BJTs are fixed-geometry models (VOL/libs.ref/sky130_fd_pr/spice): a drawn emitter of any other size is a different device than the one simulated. No `default`: a model no recipe names keeps today's sizing (the netlist's w/l).

high_po.res_model_source: sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po.model.spice (volare fa87f8f4) lines 27-40: R = 317.3885*(L+0.247)/weff + 345.8312/(weff+0.1558), weff = W - 0.001 - 0.0672*max(0.69-W, 0), W, L in um; res_narrow_permille 67 and res_head_dw_nm 156 round 0.0672 and 0.1558.

generic_po.res_model_source: rp1 = 48.2 ohm/sq, VOL/libs.tech/ngspice/r+c/res_typical__cap_typical.spice:21 (volare fa87f8f4). The model's dw = -tol_poly/2 - poly_dw/2 (+0.028 um at typical, sky130_fd_pr__model__r+c.model.spice:134) is not applied: how ngspice applies it to W was not checked (plan-03 section 5).

resistors.note: Per schematic model, the construction GPurify's sky130.deck recognises: rbody_high_po = poly_res and rpm (licon.1b slot contacts 190x2000 inside rpm+psdm), rbody_po = poly_res outside rpm/urpm.

mim_m3_1.c_model_source: C = camimc*wc*lc + cpmimc*2*(wc+lc), wc = W + m3_dw + tol_m3, lc = L + m3_dw + tol_m3 (VOL/libs.ref/sky130_fd_pr/spice/sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1.model.spice:17-18, 23-24); camimc 2.00 fF/um2, cpmimc 0.19 fF/um at typical (VOL/libs.tech/ngspice/r+c/res_typical__cap_typical__lin.spice:7-8); m3_dw = -0.025 um (VOL/libs.tech/ngspice/sky130_fd_pr__model__r+c.model.spice:82); tol_m3 = 0 at typical (r+c/res_typical__cap_typical.spice:10).

capacitors.note: Per schematic model, the construction GPurify's sky130.deck recognises: capm (terminals met4, met3) for cap_mim_m3_1. mom_m1m2 is the deck-unrecognised met1/met2 plate stack (no model), the default for a model no recipe names.

cell.npn_isolation_note: sky130 vertical NPN (npn_05v5): n+ emitter and p-tap base in the p-region a deep n-well (dnwell) and an n-well ring isolate, collector tapped on the ring; nwell.5/nwell.6 set the ring against the deep well.

waivers.multiple_drivers: Analog: a node driven by two drains (a differential pair's output and its load, a mirror's input) is the circuit, not a fault. The rule counts distinct gate nets driving a net (a digital fan-in check).
